scope: Automated geometry, state, physics and GPU fixture results. Synthesized viewport input is logic-layer evidence, not native-window/editor shortcut evidence. Artistic match and transparent/visual occlusion need a separate image review.

p7.scope: Each near/far cloud layer must have an actual mesh corner inside camera clip depths and viewport. Geometry and preset checks do not assert cloud pixels are unobstructed by every other object.

view_center.scope: Projected body-wall polygons are clipped to the viewport. Sightlines test physical colliders, excluding invisible movement barriers; rendered visual occlusion still requires image review.

view_left.scope: Projected body-wall polygons are clipped to the viewport. Sightlines test physical colliders, excluding invisible movement barriers; rendered visual occlusion still requires image review.

view_right.scope: Projected body-wall polygons are clipped to the viewport. Sightlines test physical colliders, excluding invisible movement barriers; rendered visual occlusion still requires image review.

route.teleports: Initial spawn reset and final state restoration only. Every route stop is reached with CharacterBody3D.move_and_slide.
